en: Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a broad cobblestone street lined with grand late‑19th‑century buildings. On the left is a stately two‑story villa with a balcony and fenced garden; on the right stands a larger ornate brick building with elaborate roof decorations and small towers. In the foreground a horse pulls a simple wooden cart, and a few pedestrians walk near the gated entrance. The title print at the top reads "Wurzen. Bahnhofstrasse." and there is a faint red publisher/date line along the bottom edge.
